description: Returns the validation rule builders registered with the rules plugin, or resolves rule aliases when called with a getter of a rules array. Each builder accepts an optional custom error message as its last argument.

exposed.[string]: Custom rule builder registered in the **aliases** option of the rules plugin.
exposed.capital: Creates a rule that only allows uppercase Latin letters.
exposed.email: Creates a rule that requires a valid email address. Empty values pass.
exposed.exclude: Creates a rule that fails when the value contains any of the given characters.
exposed.integer: Creates a rule that only allows digits.
exposed.maxLength: Creates a rule that fails when the value is longer than the given length. Empty values pass.
exposed.minLength: Creates a rule that fails when the value is shorter than the given length. Empty values pass.
exposed.notEmpty: Creates a rule that requires a non-empty string or array.
exposed.number: Creates a rule that requires a numeric value. Empty values pass.
exposed.pattern: Creates a rule that requires the value to match the given regular expression. Empty values pass.
exposed.required: Creates a rule that requires a value. `0` is treated as a valid value.
exposed.strictLength: Creates a rule that requires the value to have exactly the given length. Empty values pass.
